# DataTable

The table for every list of records: sortable headers, sticky header, right-aligned numbers, selection, row actions, grouping, flagged and now rows, density, a…

`SongNodes.DataTable` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.DataTable rows={…} columns={…} rowId={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.DataTable" rows="{{…}}" columns="{{…}}" row-id="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (DataTableProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` * | `T[]` | Rows to show. |
| `columns` * | `DataTableColumn<T>[]` | Column definitions. |
| `rowId` * | `(row: T) => string` | Row id accessor. |
| `caption` * | `string` | Caption naming the table and its scope ("Crate · 12 of 1,284 tracks"). |
| `sort` | `{ column: string; direction: "ascending" \| "descending" }` | Current sort; one column at a time. |
| `onSortChange` | `(sort: { column: string; direction: "ascending" \| "descending" }) => void` | Called when a header is activated. |
| `tiebreak` | `(row: T) => string` | Tiebreak accessor applied after the sort column (default artist then title). |
| `selected` | `Set<string>` | Selected row ids; enables the checkbox column and select-all. |
| `onSelectionChange` | `(ids: Set<string>) => void` | Selection change handler. |
| `groupBy` | `(row: T) => string` | Group rows by this accessor; group header shows the name and count. |
| `groups` | `{ key: string; label: string }[]` | Order of group keys and their display names. |
| `isFlagged` | `(row: T) => boolean` | Flagged rows get flag-bg. |
| `isNow` | `(row: T) => boolean` | The now row gets the 3px now bar. |
| `rowActions` | `(row: T) => ReactNode` | Row actions rendered at row end (quiet icon buttons, then OverflowMenu). |
| `bulkActions` | `(ids: Set<string>) => ReactNode` | Bulk actions shown in the toolbar when rows are selected. |
| `density` | `"comfortable" \| "compact"` | Row height; persisted per person via SongNodes.prefs.setDensity. |
| `visibleColumns` | `string[]` | Visible column ids; persisted per person. |
| `state` | `"data" \| "loading" \| "empty" \| "error"` | Data state; non-data states replace the body with one explanatory row. |
| `emptyMessage` | `{ title: string; body: string; action?: ReactNode }` | Empty and error copy plus their single action. |
| `errorMessage` | `{ title: string; body: string; action?: ReactNode }` | Error copy: what happened and what to do next. |
| `maxHeight` | `string` | Max height of the scroll box before the sticky header takes over (default 480px). |
| `keyboard` | `boolean` | Keyboard row navigation (J/K, arrows, Enter, Space, T): the scroll box takes focus; default false. |
| `activeRowId` | `string` | Id of the keyboard-active row (outlined, not selected). |
| `onActiveRowChange` | `(id: string) => void` | Called when J/K or the arrow keys move the active row. |
| `onRowOpen` | `(row: T) => void` | Enter on the active row (open the track). |
| `rowShortcuts` | `Record<string, (row: T) => void>` | Single-letter quick actions on the active row, e.g. { t: addToTargets, " ": togglePreview }. |

### DataTableColumn

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` | Stable column id (persisted in the column chooser). |
| `header` * | `string` | Header text, sentence case. |
| `numeric` | `boolean` | Right-align and use tabular mono figures. |
| `sortValue` | `(row: T) => string \| number \| null` | Sort accessor; omit for unsortable columns. |
| `cell` * | `(row: T) => ReactNode` | Cell renderer. |
| `defaultVisible` | `boolean` | Visible by default (crate: Energy, Track, BPM, Key, Pillar, Rotation, Heard, Last heard). |
| `fixed` | `boolean` | Cannot be hidden (Track). |
| `stackLabel` | `string` | Label used on the stacked phone card; defaults to header. |
